content.short: CardanoScan is a blockchain explorer and analytics platform for searching Cardano on-chain activity.
content.description: CardanoScan is a blockchain explorer and analytics platform for Cardano. It allows users to search transactions, addresses, blocks, epoch slots, pools, stake keys, policy IDs, asset names, and fingerprints from a single interface. The platform is built as a general-purpose inspection layer for Cardano, giving users a straightforward way to look up on-chain data and follow network activity.
